name: Ryokan
description: A hot spring inn's landing page and booking: the valley with steam rising, three rooms, the baths with live hours and occupancy, a seasonal dinner menu, a small line map for getting there, a booking card and a waterline footer.

props.name: images
props.type: { hero?: string; rooms?: string[]; bath?: string }
props.description: Pictures for the page: the valley behind the hero, one for each of the three rooms in order (river, garden, snow-viewing), and the open-air bath. Any image URL. Without them each space shows a soft wash.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. The page grows with its content and scrolls; Check availability and each room's button scroll to the booking card. Bath occupancy follows the viewer's clock; booking dates are fixed in February and March 2027. Also accepts every other div attribute.
